subtasks.title: make the trailing newline not count as a line
subtasks.goal:
Fix count::lines in src/count.rs. A text that ends with a newline has as many lines as it has newline characters, not one more; a text without a trailing newline has as many lines as it has newlines plus one. The empty string stays at zero. Add regression tests in the existing tests module: lines("a
b
") is 2, lines("a
b") is 2, lines("a
") is 1, and the empty case still returns 0.

dod.statement: the trailing newline no longer adds a phantom line, and a regression test pins both spellings of a two-line file to the same answer
